# Trusted Choice

> > Trusted Choice connects consumers with 250,000+ independent insurance agents across the U.S., offering personalized matching for home, auto, business, and specialized industry insurance coverage.

Trusted Choice is a comprehensive insurance agent directory and matching platform that helps individuals and businesses find local independent agents. The site provides industry-specific insurance guides organized by NAICS classification, covering everything from personal insurance to specialized commercial coverage for agriculture, manufacturing, construction, and professional services sectors.

## Key Topics

- Independent Insurance Agents
- Business Insurance
- Commercial Insurance
- Agent Matching
- Insurance Directory
- NAICS Classification
- Industry Guides
- Risk Management
- Liability Coverage
- Personal Insurance
- Home & Auto Insurance
- Insurance Quotes
- Professional Services Insurance
- Manufacturing Insurance
- Construction Insurance

## Core Services

- [Independent Insurance Agents | Trusted Choice](https://www.trustedchoice.com/agent): Directory of 250,000+ independent insurance agents searchable by state/location
- [Independent Insurance Agents for Home, Auto & More | Trusted Choice](https://www.trustedchoice.com): Homepage for Trusted Choice insurance agent directory and matching service
- [National Insurance Company Directory | Trusted Choice](https://www.trustedchoice.com/insurance-companies): Directory connecting users to insurance companies and local agents
